_: The five findings of the onyx (Dossier) hero, filled from the sealed record ~/Documents/cascade-dossier/releve-public.json at seal `sceau`. Address grammar in `source`, resolved against that record: {cle, champ} reads releve[cle][champ]; {compte-verdicts: {controle, tenu}} counts verdicts with that controle and tenu across questions[*].verdicts; {compte-questions: {etat}} counts questions with that etat. Every displayed figure was derived from the record at writing time and re-verified mechanically (hardened citation script, displayed-precision rule). The figures tell the record's own day-one truth: coverage 3 of 4 with the fourth named missing, two seals recomputed, zero signatures verifiable yet and the Dossier says so, one report present that cannot even state its measurement day. `annotations` were measured and written against the five delivered renders (escalier-reel/parchemin-01..05): each label describes what its own frame shows. Note for the merge: the themes of states 3 (empty SIGNED step) and 4 (freshness rings) sit one step off findings 03 (freshness) and 04 (coherence); the labels follow the frames, and the pairing is the chef's call at re-render time.

findings.titre: A seal is checked, not trusted.
findings.phrase: A seal is recomputed before anything else is believed, and a signature is verified, never assumed. Today the Dossier finds two seals that match, and zero verifiable signatures across the suite: it prints the zero instead of waving it through, because nothing is called valid unverified.
findings.leg_a: seals recomputed and matching, on the reports read
findings.leg_b: public-record signatures verifiable today, and the Dossier says so, one refusal per report
annotations: the sealed step: both fingerprints recomputed here
four house seals at the lectern, none verifiable yet

findings.titre: A measurement ages. The Dossier says by how much.
findings.phrase: Fresh, due, or stale: every measurement is dated against the rhythm you declare. And a report that cannot even state its measurement day is named for exactly that: age you cannot judge is not age zero.
findings.leg_a: measurements fresh under the declared rhythm at the day of this Dossier
findings.leg_b: report whose freshness cannot be judged at all: it carries no measurement day

findings.titre: One dataset, one seal: incoherence is named.
findings.phrase: The same dataset cannot carry two seals, and a report from an unknown tool version is named rather than guessed. Coherence is a check the Dossier runs across everything it reads, and its verdicts say what there was to cross-check, not more.
findings.leg_a: coherence checks passed, each report alone on its question so far, and the verdict says so
findings.leg_b: controls the Dossier runs on every report: present, sealed, signed, fresh, consistent
annotations: brass rings: measured zero days ago, in rhythm
no ring at the foot: an age nobody can compute

findings.titre: Your reviewer verifies it without us.
findings.phrase: The Dossier is written next to your files, sealed with the same fingerprint the whole suite uses, and it judges freshness against a rhythm you declare, named in the record as a declaration. Nothing leaves your machine, and nothing about the verdict requires our word.
findings.leg_a: questions the piece answers as one, for the whole chain
findings.leg_b: days of the declared review rhythm it judges freshness against: an assumption, named

the lectern: the piece your reviewer verifies alone
